question: Can lossless 16-bit staging complete the entire original pair and preserve user-facing accuracy, physical depth and measured performance under host memory pressure?
protocol: One 180-request matched direct pair. Both arms use identical native Qwen thinking prompts, unconstrained greedy generation, source histories, real callbacks and output caps. Record time, first-token wait, peak, prefill and decode alongside all successes. Require >=6 net improvements and zero lost successes separately in database, strategy and financial families with two-sided exact p<=0.05. For database cases use schema-cluster sign flips and positive gains under each of the four conditions. Each short family requires at least as many completions. Four unabridged prompts above 131072 tokens must all be correct and strictly exceed Base. Require lower total wall, first-token wait and peak and faster opening and decode. Grade all 176 masked short cases before examining the cost or decision. A joint pass is prerequisite to the fully matched ordinary-depth training, second independent seed, broad retention and clean 128K deployment. All failed registered prerequisites close downstream stages. Replay both complete arms from the first item. Apply grouped full-precision disk staging to both arms on openings of 32768 or more tokens. Preserve all six attention histories, folded final recurrent reads, official thinking prompts, pinned weights, scoring, identical order and the original blinded reading. Require positive scratch use below 4 GiB on each staged turn. The original incomplete study used 102.277 seconds. Reserve at most 4380 native seconds per model in two independently closed windows, 8760 seconds total. Both models pay all staging I/O. The original incomplete attempt and separate engineering qualification are reported in addition. Record failed request attempts separately and add all their elapsed time to the recovered item's wall and first-response time, with the maximum peak retained. Never repeat a finished item. On system pressure release the process and require ten nominal seconds. Stop on the second failed attempt for the same item, after four pressure restarts, two hours of elapsed availability per arm, a resource cap or any failed original gate. Read no individual scores or aggregate product outcomes before the full committed masked review.
